fact: As of 11 June 2025, seven schools, two in Djibouti-ville and five in the interior regions, had been connected under the Djibouti Fondation Numérique project, per the ministry's TICE director general.
title: Projet "Djibouti Fondation Numérique"/Education : réduction significative de la fracture numérique entre la capitale et les régions
